jsonld_raw.name: FASHIONABLY LONDON EDP 100ML (3.4 FL.OZ).
jsonld_raw.description:
FASHIONABLY LONDON EDP 100ML (3.4 FL.OZ). Evokes the relaxed sophistication of London and that feeling of summer air sweeping through the city: a stroll through Knightsbridge, a coffee break, the open light in Hyde Park. Bergamot provides luminous freshness, rose introduces a modern femininity, and musk creates a clean, polished base that blends in naturally.

A collection created by Ms. Jo Malone CBE, founder of Jo Loves.

Musky Floral | Elegant, luminous, and contemporary
